Subject: Request: Article 28/30 packet + remote audit logistics

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Helios legal is starting our vendor onboarding checklist and we need to arrange a remote audit facilitation and packet of documentation under our DPA review. To proceed we need the following items by COB next Wednesday (21 Mar):

- Latest Article 28 subprocessor inventory (CSV preferred) with subprocessors' country and transfer mechanism
- An excerpt of Article 30 processing records relevant to 'user messaging' and 'analytics' (sample CSV or ledger extract)
- SOC 2 Type II (last 12 months) and any recent pen-test summary
- Confirmation of audit rights: scope, remote session windows, and evidence access method (read-only audit portal or SFTP)
- Clarification on KMS key management (who holds keys for EU-region models/keys; Do you support customer-managed keys?)

Also attaching our onboarding form (we'll upload a short checklist to your audit portal if you prefer). Please confirm who at Redwood will be the point of contact for any further questions.

Thanks,
Eleni Papadopoulos
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Helios Health

2) Marissa to pull SOC2 Type II attestation + pen-test summary and upload to the audit portal.

Also, Helios asked specifically about KMS/customer-managed keys — Ben, can you reply with the current product stance and any ops-run exceptions for dedicated/private customers?

Eleni — we aim to deliver the initial packet by Tue 13 Mar EOD and propose two remote session windows (Thu 15 Mar 09:00-11:00 UTC or Fri 16 Mar 14:00-16:00 UTC). Will either work for Helios?
